text: Entry Requirements 1) Aged 16 years or above, in good health conditions 2) Non-Chinese citizen: as required by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC. 3) Senior high school graduate 4) Chinese language requirements: Valid HSK test report should be submitted. a. Chinese Language Program & Program of Teaching Chinese to the Speakers of Other Languages (for international students only): New HSK 4 ≥180 b. Arts programs: New HSK 4 ≥180 (no less than 60 in each module) c. Sciences & engineering programs: New HSK 4 ≥195 (no less than 65 in each module) d. Humanities, economics & management programs: New HSK 4 ≥210 (no less than 70 in each module) Applicants who hold the following certifications are not required of HSK test reports: a. SAT II Chinese with Listening, score≥600 b. IB Chinese HL Course, score≥6 c. A-level Chinese Course, score≥A d. AP Chinese Course or relevant certifications e. High school education offered in Chinese f . CSC pre-college certificate obtained
